description: Inspect the current domain_trust signal producer to determine why it only yields 4 distinct values. Query DuckDB: SELECT DISTINCT score FROM mcp_signal_scores WHERE signal_type='domain_trust' LIMIT 50. If the cardinality is below 20, generate a domain_trust_enrichment.py companion module that reads multiple metadata fields (registry_source, age_days, publisher_verified, stars, download_count, dependency_count) to produce richer score discrimination. The enrichment must expose compute_score(metadata) -> tuple[float, dict] conforming to the signal invariant contract. This targets the same plateau as permission_scope/temporal_stability/tool_description_safety but via the primary domain_trust signal which the spec does not defer.
